cases.sourceText: Return to Panem for the 50th Hunger Games! In “The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping,” young Haymitch Abernathy faces a deadly fight for survival as the Capitol doubles the number of tributes. Experience the action, suspense, and rebellion on the largest dome screen in the Bay Area in our IMAX® Dome Theater, featuring stunning visuals and powerful sound.

cases.sourceText: Our partner, Budding Leaders, is hosting arts and crafts classes for ages 4+ with adult help, 8+ solo. We will supply materials and samples and help you create beautiful art work. Tickets available at the desk 30 minutes before program starts. All individuals (of any age) attending need a ticket and must be present to receive their ticket.

Tickets are available at the desk 30 minutes before the program starts. Everyone attending needs a ticket and must be present to get one.
